settings.heading: Form follows function. Still.
settings.text:
Modernist Interiors began with a simple frustration: good modern design was either priced like a museum piece or copied badly. We set out to find the middle ground: pieces with clean geometry, honest materials and a reason for every line.

We work with a small set of makers and suppliers, test what we sell, and keep our range deliberately small, so every lamp, table and object earns its place.

settings.title: Form follows function
settings.text: Shapes that exist for a reason. If it doesn't serve the room, it doesn't make the cut.

settings.title: Curated, not cluttered
settings.text: A tight edit of modern and Bauhaus-inspired pieces instead of thousands of look-alikes.

settings.title: Honest pricing
settings.text: Fair prices, clear shipping times and no fake countdowns. What you see is what you pay.

settings.heading: Three principles behind every piece
settings.text: The Bauhaus taught that good design should be useful, beautiful and within reach. We still think so.

settings.title: Free shipping
settings.text: On every order, tracked to your door. US & Canada 3–7 days · International 5–8 days.

settings.title: Design classics
settings.text: Bauhaus and mid-century forms, faithfully interpreted.

settings.title: 30-day returns
settings.text: Live with it first. Send it back if it isn’t right.

settings.heading: Join the studio
settings.text: New arrivals and design stories, sent sparingly.
